name: Tryon's Farm
description: In Glastonbury, CT, Tryon's Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Pumpkins, and Asparagus on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
